notes:
# Search everything you have recorded {search}
Press Command-K and type. RecordLah looks through meeting names, folders,
the notes it wrote and every word that was said. Open a result and it
takes you to the meeting — to the line in the transcript where that was
said, or to the notes with your words marked.

# Your meetings keep the time zone you made them in {globe}
Set a meeting in Singapore, land in Vietnam, and it still starts when the
rest of the meeting does. RecordLah also tells you when your Mac has
moved, and what that did to anything already scheduled.

# Webinars that used to wait on Zoom's preview now get in {video}
A Zoom Events webinar could sit on the "Join" preview until it gave up
twenty minutes later, with the meeting going on without you. RecordLah
now presses the right window.

---

Everything else in this release:

- Notes come back complete instead of brief, and say when something on
  screen could not be read rather than guessing at it.
- A copy of a meeting says "Choose a date" instead of showing today's
  date in a field it will not accept.
- The time zone card counts every meeting it moved, shows the times you
  set rather than a minute earlier, and no longer names the same zone
  twice.
